scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:rust
scripts.check:full: pnpm run check && pnpm run test:browser
scripts.test: pnpm --filter suplex-web build && env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN cargo build --manifest-path apps/server/Cargo.toml --bin suplex --features github-test-endpoint && vitest run --project unit && pnpm --filter suplex-web test
scripts.test:guarded: env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN cargo run --quiet --manifest-path apps/server/Cargo.toml --example guarded-tests --
scripts.test:browser: pnpm --filter suplex-web build && env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN cargo build --manifest-path apps/server/Cargo.toml --bin suplex --features github-test-endpoint && vitest run --config vitest.browser.config.ts
scripts.test:rust: env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN RUST_TEST_THREADS=4 cargo test --manifest-path apps/server/Cargo.toml --all-targets
